changelog:
- Critical VPN Offline Bugfix: Fixed Android WebView offline/connection failure (ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED) when Tor or Custom VPN is turned on.
- Strict Proxy Reachability Guard: Prevents WebView from routing traffic to closed ports or unreachable proxies; cleanly falls back to Direct connection.
- SOCKS5 Remote DNS Resolution: Preserves socks5:// scheme and adds MATCH_ALL_SCHEMES and addDirect() fallback so all HTTP and HTTPS traffic resolves securely without offline errors.
- Startup Safe Recovery: Checks saved proxy availability on app launch and automatically resets to Direct mode if the remote proxy is offline.
